subject: general
question: Which state hosted the Khelo India Youth Games, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state of **Bihar** has been officially selected to host the **7th edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)** in **2025**.
 
• This announcement was made by the **Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Shri Mansukh Mandaviya**, during a meeting with state sports ministers, signifying a major shift in hosting national events in the eastern part of India.
 
• It will be the **first time** in history that **Bihar** will host this prestigious national multi-sport competition, highlighting the state’s growing commitment to developing **sports infrastructure** and talent.
 
• The **2025** edition aims to provide a platform for approximately **7,000 to 8,000 athletes** from across the country to compete in various sporting disciplines.
 
• The **Government of Bihar** is expected to utilize venues in **Patna** and other districts to conduct the games, promoting a sports culture at the **grassroots level** within the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Previous Edition (2024):**
 
 
• The **6th edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games** was hosted by **Tamil Nadu** in **January 2024**.
 
• The games were held across four cities: **Chennai**, **Madurai**, **Trichy**, and **Coimbatore**.
 
• **Maharashtra** emerged as the overall champion of the **2024** games, securing the top spot in the medal tally.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of KIYG:**
 
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** (formerly known as **Khelo India School Games**) were launched in **2018** by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• The inaugural edition was held in **New Delhi**, and since then, it has become the biggest talent-identification platform in Indian sports.
 
• The games are organized in two categories: **under-17 years** for school students and **under-21 years** for college and university students.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of Khelo India:**
 
 
• The primary objective of the **Khelo India** initiative is to revive the **sports culture** in India by integrating sports with the education system and identifying talent at a young age.
 
• Selected athletes receive an annual financial assistance of **Rs. 5 lakh** for a period of **8 years** to prepare for international competitions, including the **Olympics**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Maharashtra** and **Haryana** have been the most successful states in the history of the **Khelo India Youth Games**, often alternating for the top position in the medal table.
 
• In the **2024** edition, **Silambam** (a traditional martial art of **Tamil Nadu**) was featured as a **demo sport** for the first time.
 
• The hosting of the **2025** games in **Bihar** is part of the **"Sports for All"** vision, ensuring that states with untapped potential get the opportunity to upgrade their facilities and showcase local talent.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** uses a **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** in conjunction with **Khelo India** to ensure the best young athletes receive world-class training and exposure.
